findings.title: Legacy visualstudio.com path with no repo returns bare org
findings.problem: For a *.visualstudio.com HTTPS remote whose path contains only _git and/or DefaultCollection, rest is empty and result becomes [org], so a bare org name is returned instead of an owner/repo-shaped value or undefined.
findings.impact: Malformed or degenerate remotes yield a name lacking owner/repo shape, grouping analytics wrongly. Reachability is confirmed in code but requires an unusual remote.
findings.recommendation: After computing rest, return undefined when rest.length === 0.

findings.title: Lone '~' first segment yields empty repo name
findings.problem: The leading-tilde strip slices result[0] unconditionally, so a first segment of exactly '~' becomes an empty string. Result is '' or '/repo' and the result.length === 0 guard does not catch it. This also leaves the story criterion 'unparseable remote behaviour unchanged' partial (acceptance lens), since previously such input returned '~'-based or undefined output.
findings.impact: A bogus empty or leading-slash repo name is emitted instead of undefined or the prior value. Required acceptance criterion is only partially met.
findings.recommendation: Strip only when result[0].length > 1 (e.g. if (result[0].startsWith('~') && result[0].length > 1)), and return undefined when the final joined value is empty. Add a test for https://example.com/ and a lone '~' segment.
